verdict.rationale: Firstbase documents that founders can appoint or switch to Firstbase as their Registered Agent, with a per-state compliance dashboard (firstbase-docs-1, -7, -14, -28). Its Mailroom scans physical mail into high-resolution PDFs (firstbase-docs-18), but that is a virtual-mailbox feature and the evidence never ties it to registered-agent legal mail. Nothing explicitly covers digital delivery of service of process. Missing for 10: explicit digital forwarding or notification of service of process, confirmation that registered-agent legal mail is scanned into the dashboard, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
